title: With the keyboard in a New Tab page's field, Ctrl-PageDown / Ctrl-PageUp and Ctrl-Cmd-] / Ctrl-Cmd-[ select the next / previous sidebar workspace, even in a pane with two tabs
preconditions: private scratch config (workspaces.newPlacement top, the default: a new workspace is listed first)
a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab with the keyboard
the default key bindings (Next / Previous Sidebar Item on Ctrl-Cmd-] / [ with Ctrl-PageDown / PageUp as aliases)
converted from scripts/cmux-next/prev-next-webview-e2e.py, which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-095.json links them

steps.note: the script makes three workspaces; a socket run without focus files this one without showing it
listed on top: the sidebar reads third-workspace, second-workspace, the launch workspace
the middle workspace, so neither key wraps past the list's ends
Cmd-T: a New Tab page beside the terminal tab, its field with the keyboard. The pane has two tabs, the start where Chrome's tab keys and Previous / Next differ
script row 'Ctrl-PageDown from the New Tab field': nextSidebarTab, one workspace down (the launch workspace)
Cmd-T in the launch workspace: its pane gets a New Tab page beside the terminal tab, and its field has the keyboard, so the next press starts from a field too
script row 'Ctrl-PageUp from the New Tab field': prevSidebarTab, back to the middle workspace, whose New Tab page is still its pane's shown tab
the keyboard comes back to the middle workspace's New Tab field after the switch (asynchronously), before the next press
script row 'Ctrl-Cmd-] from the New Tab field': nextSidebarTab, one workspace down (the launch workspace)
the keyboard comes back to the launch workspace's New Tab field, before the next press
script row 'Ctrl-Cmd-[ from the New Tab field': prevSidebarTab, back to the middle workspace

invariants: focus/windows/0/model/resolved is agentPage at field, launch-new-tab-page, back-in-field and launch-field: a New Tab page's field has the keyboard before each of the four presses

layout/screens/0/workspace at ctrl-pagedown, launch-new-tab-page, ctrl-cmd-next and launch-field is the launch workspace (launched's), the one below second-workspace; at ctrl-pageup, back-in-field, ctrl-cmd-previous and ended it is second-workspace's created/0
at ended, second-workspace's pane and the launch workspace's pane each still hold their two tabs: no key stepped or closed a pane's tabs
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the action each key ran (nextSidebarTab, prevSidebarTab): a key step's expect sees that an action ran, not which; the shown workspace's change is what the case compares
the palette lists Next Sidebar Item and Previous Sidebar Item with their keys (debug.palette.entries): no facet records palette rows before a query
the script's one-tab start: in a 1-tab pane Previous / Next also step the sidebar, so only the 2-tab start tells the Chrome tab keys apart from them
